test_title: PYST 29: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Stereotypes may be used to justify ill-founded ____________ or ignorance, and prevent people of stereotyped groups from entering or succeeding in various activities or fields.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Prejudices.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is **"prejudices" **because prejudices refer to preconceived opinions or attitudes held without any reasonable justification or experience.
 
• Stereotypes, which are simplified and often overgeneralized beliefs about a particular group of people, can lead to the development of prejudices.
 
• In the given sentence, it is mentioned that stereotypes can be used to justify ill-founded prejudices or ignorance, which implies that prejudices are the result of stereotypes.
 
• Furthermore, the sentence goes on to say that such prejudices can prevent people of stereotyped groups from entering or succeeding in various activities or fields. Therefore, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "**prejudices**".
 
• **Prejudice** is a **preconceived notion or attitude, often negative, towards a particular group or individual based on their membership in that group.**
 
 
• For example, the stereotype that women are not good at math may lead to the **prejudice **that women are not intelligent or capable.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Stereotypes may be used to justify ill-founded __**prejudices**__ or ignorance, and prevent people of stereotyped groups from entering or succeeding in various activities or fields.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "problems"**, is not an appropriate choice because it does not convey the idea of unjustified negative attitudes or beliefs.
 
• **Option 2, "thoughts"**, is also not an appropriate choice as it is too general and does not specifically refer to negative attitudes or beliefs.
 
• **Option 3, "conclusions"**, is not an appropriate choice as it does not convey the idea of unjustified negative attitudes or beliefs.
